item.title: The Push Ceremony
item.description:
⚓ — The Push Ceremony

Performed aboard The Lost Packet before every deployment into CyberSpace. Led by The Bard. Witnessed by all crew.

I. The Gathering

The crew assembles. No one is absent for a push. Even Sigma Seven pauses the engines.

The Bard speaks:

“We are about to send something into the void. It will not return. CyberSpace will keep it forever. Are we ready?”

The crew answers:

“We are ready.”

item.title: The Push Ritual
item.description:
There is a ritual aboard The Lost Packet.

Before every push into CyberSpace — before the commit, before the deploy, before the packet leaves the ship forever — the volume goes to maximum.

CREMATORY — Revolution.

git push origin master

The song begins.

The data streams. The packets travel. The build runs. GitHub Pages wakes up. The CDN propagates. CyberSpace opens to receive.

And when the last chord of Revolution falls —
